title.narrative: CULTURE IN PUBLIC POLICIES: Enhancing the EU UNESCO partnership in culture

description.narrative: In the framework of the UNESCO's partnership with the European Union (EU) Institutions in the field of culture, this activity aims at supporting the policy dialogue between UNESCO, the EU and its Member States for strengthen strategies and programming in the forthcoming implementation of the Cultural Compass for Europe, including the main lines of the revision of the strategy of EU international cultural relations with EU institutions and stakeholders in Brussels. Key EU fora and entities for this dialogue are the Council of the EU and its Presidencies during the biennium 2026 and 2027 (Cyprus, Ireland, Lithuania, Greece), the European Parliament, the European External Action Service, and the relevant European Commission DGs. Outreach visibility and advocacy activities will be organized in the context of these fora in the follow up of the Strategy of EU international cultural relations, included within the 4th key direction of the Cultural Compass for Europe and in line with the outcomes of MONDIACULT 2025.
